articles.title: Service Changes on Rochdale Line Due to Planned Works
articles.excerpt: Planned track renewal works on the Rochdale line will result in service changes and a bus replacement service until 28 August, affecting travel in the area.
articles.content_html:
Transport for Greater Manchester (TfGM) has announced that planned works will affect tram services on the Rochdale line from Saturday 15 August until Friday 28 August. During this period, service changes will be implemented, and a bus replacement service will operate between affected stops.

Additionally, no trams will operate via Exchange Square in Manchester city centre on Saturday 15 and Sunday 16 August due to works at Manchester Town Hall. Services on the East Didsbury and Trafford Centre lines will instead run via Market Street and Shudehill.

Passengers are advised to plan their journeys accordingly, as these disruptions may affect travel times. For those requiring step-free access, the lifts at Failsworth tram stop are currently out of service, and passengers should travel to Hollinwood for alternative connections.

TfGM encourages customers to check their travel alerts page for the latest updates and to contact the Metrolink customer service for assistance with journey planning. The contact number is 0161 244 1000, with lines open from 7am to 8pm on weekdays and 8am to 8pm on weekends and bank holidays.

articles.title: Lift Out of Service at Derker Tram Stop Until Further Notice
articles.excerpt: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers travelling towards and away from Manchester.
articles.content_html:
The lift at Derker tram stop has been reported out of service since Friday, 14 August 2026, at 6:30pm. The disruption is expected to continue until further notice, impacting passengers' access to the tram services.

For those travelling towards Manchester, step-free access is available via a ramp from Cromford Street directly to the Manchester-bound platform. Passengers heading towards Rochdale can also use a ramp from Cromford Street, but must cross the tracks to reach the Rochdale-bound platform.

Transport for Greater Manchester (TfGM) has apologised for any inconvenience caused by this disruption and is advising passengers to plan their journeys accordingly.

Further updates regarding the lift's status will be provided as they become available. Passengers are encouraged to check the TfGM website for live travel alerts and additional information.

articles.title: Rochdale Borough Council Updates Contact Information for Estates and Asset Management Team
articles.excerpt: Rochdale Borough Council has updated its contact details for the Estates and Asset Management Team, providing residents with easier access to services.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale Borough Council has announced an update to the contact information for its Estates and Asset Management Team. This change aims to improve accessibility for residents seeking assistance with property and asset-related inquiries.

The updated contact details can be found on the council's official website, ensuring that residents have the most current information available. This is part of the council's ongoing efforts to enhance communication and service delivery.

Residents are encouraged to visit the council's website for further details and to reach out to the team for any estate management needs they may have.

For more information, residents can access the updated contact details at the Rochdale Borough Council's website.
